claim_ceiling: Training-split Kanzi pipeline decomposition only. These custom Kanzi archives are exact competitor diagnostics, not Axiom artifacts, Axiom wins, validation results, private-holdout results, novel-algorithm results, or state-of-the-art evidence.

decision.rejection: If no one augmentation variant passes the admission gate on both tracks, reject implicit-reference long-range factorization as the next shared text/source successor. Track-specific signals may motivate separately frozen successors but cannot satisfy the shared admission.

measurement.baseline_source: Reuse exact per-item kanzi-max complete bytes from the immutable 630-trial practical census; do not rerun or replace them.

name: text-source-long-range-kanzi-decomposition-screen-v1

research_basis.finding: Large standard compressors can miss far-apart repetitions because of local windows; approximate LZ77 precompression can assist a standard backend on large repetitive text.
LZ77 is especially effective on repetitive software repositories and versioned document collections.
A practical bidirectional parse can use fewer phrases than left-only LZ77, motivating a later multi-reference search while keeping this screen strictly backward-decodable.
